entities.summary: Elizabeth II, a notable figure in the history of Barbados, associated with Contemporary Barbados and the Republic Transition (2018–2025). Preceded by Rihanna declared a National Hero at republic ceremony and Sandra Mason sworn in as first President of Barbados. Their legacy influenced Mia Mottley and International Climate Leadership and Barbados becomes a republic on November 30, 2021.
